verdict.rationale: Docs describe an end-to-end autonomous bug-fix flow (assign via GitHub issue label, clone+plan+fix+diff+PR: jules-docs-2,3,4,7,8,9), but community reports are split — some praise successful autonomous fixes and PRs (jules-comm-2,6,11,15,16) while many report it getting stuck in loops, needing heavy babysitting, failing on complex/monorepo codebases, and producing lower-quality output than competitors (jules-comm-9,10,13,14,18).
